model_input_contract: Only target_units/source_units/fixed_pairs/allow_source_union are model inputs. Never reveal expectation, target_facets, objective_scope or prior observations to the candidate generator or blinded adjudicator.

metrics_contract.objective_accuracy_denominator: objective_control labels only, reported separately by partition and domain
metrics_contract.strict_false_accept: predicted strict when an objective pair is labeled lenient or weak
metrics_contract.lenient_false_accept: predicted lenient or strict when objective weak
metrics_contract.false_reject: predicted weak for objective strict or lenient
metrics_contract.insufficient: report abstention counts separately, including false abstention on complete objective controls
metrics_contract.literal_grounding: source quote substring validity plus independent target-span coverage and required-facet status; never replace semantic checks with quote validity
metrics_contract.reviewer_constraints: unweighted real cases are evaluated for grounding/unknown-status and no invented claims; never counted as gold tier accuracy
metrics_contract.scenario_metrics: distinct-source matching and confirmed/possible outcome bounds; segmentation policy probes separate from accuracy

limitations: Not an estimate of population-level academic accuracy.
Known historical failures informed development selection; heldout inputs/labels are sealed from v6 tuning.
No component-count percentage is a gold label. Explicit verse scopes use the already stated numeric policy.
